item.title: An Evening of Literary Exchange: Ambassador of Türkiye Hosts Exclusive Reception Celebrating India-Türkiye Literary Bonds at New Delhi World Book Fair 2026
item.description: New Delhi, 16th January 2026: H.E. Mr. Ali Murat Ersoy, Ambassador of the Republic of Türkiye to India, hosted an elegant literary reception at his residence on 14th January 2026, bringing together the vibrant worlds of Indian and Turkish literature in celebration of the New Delhi World Book Fair 2026. The exclusive evening marked a significant milestone in cultural diplomacy between the two nations, honouring their shared reverence for the written word and centuries-old storytelling traditions.
